import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class E {
    static int rows;
    static int cols;
    static int[][][] memo;
    static final int[] rowOffset = { 0, 0, 1, -1 };
    static final int[] colOffset = { 1, -1, 0, 0 };
    static final int NEG_INF = -1000000;

    public static int solve(int row, int currentMask, int previousMask) {
        if (row == rows) {
            return (previousMask == 0) ? 0 : NEG_INF;
        }
        if (memo[row][currentMask][previousMask] != -1) {
            return memo[row][currentMask][previousMask];
        }
        int best = 0;
        int maxMask = 1 << cols;
        for (int placement = 0; placement < maxMask; placement++) {
            int prev = previousMask;
            int curr = currentMask;
            int nextRow = maxMask - 1;
            for (int bit = 0; bit < cols; bit++) {
                if ((placement & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                    if (bit > 0) curr &= ~(1 << (bit - 1));
                    if (bit < cols - 1) curr &= ~(1 << (bit + 1));
                    nextRow &= ~(1 << bit);
                    prev &= ~(1 << bit);
                }
            }
            if (prev != 0) continue;
            int count = cols - Integer.bitCount(placement);
            int nextVal = solve(row + 1, nextRow, curr & ~placement);
            best = Math.max(best, count + nextVal);
        }
        memo[row][currentMask][previousMask] = best;
        return best;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = scanner.nextInt();
        int b = scanner.nextInt();
        rows = Math.max(a, b);
        cols = Math.min(a, b);
        memo = new int[rows][1 << cols][1 << cols];
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << cols); j++) {
                Arrays.fill(memo[i][j], -1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve(0, (1 << cols) - 1, 0));
    }
}
